accessibility.name: Browse the shelf, then step into the shop.

texts: Donkey sells useful things for home and kitchen: simple, sturdy, and priced so you don't have to think twice.
Holds four litres. Works on every hob.
Browse the shelf, then step into the shop.
See every product and its price in pounds, the bare price only. When one catches your eye, sign up and buy it in Donkey app.
Every product the team keeps on the shelf, with a short description and its price.
Read the delivery and returns details before you commit to anything.
The Sign up button opens Donkey app, where the buying happens.
Sign up once and every product and price is a tap away.
Plain, useful things for the home and the garden, chosen by Donkey and sent out from our workshop.
Donkey, a small shop for everyday things.
